source.note: The official FIA WEC entry sheet for the #36 Alpine A424 shows a 'Tyre partner' logo; the logo is Michelin's (the image's own alt text reads 'Michelin'). Michelin is the championship's tyre supplier. The page carries no publication date; the date given is the date the page was opened.

summary: 2026 Alpine A424 (WEC Hypercar, cars #35 and #36). The club's 19/03/2026 announcement names its 2026 partner ecosystem of 16 brands: premium partners ELF and H. Moser & Cie, long-standing partners Eurodatacar, Cheops Technology, M4Markets, Ixell, Businessolver, GCR, France Toner, Devoteam, Havas, Dewesoft and Sabelt, and new joiners Alten, Mobilize Financial Services and Milwaukee Tool. The club does not publish a placement map for the car, so every partner is entered as 'partner'. Michelin is the championship tyre supplier (league-partner). Series partner DHL is also visible on the car but is a WEC series partner, not a club deal.
